objective: Search (law, state) pairs with flips and learning steps at most one unit above the floor from the declared starts (R1, R2).
status: Closed 2026-11-10: the pre-registered breadth-first search stopped at its cap on all 9 starts (inconclusive). Post hoc, not pre-registered: a targeted search over the same moves moved the leftover from one Fano atom to the other on all 9, in 16 to 43 moves with 4 to 16 learning steps, the atoms' roles swapping (7) or both turning transparent (2).
title: Swapping the atoms' roles by learning at a rise
